scientific_name: Robust biweight location, midvariance and scale
common_name: Robust biweight location, midvariance and scale
scientific_use: Estimate robust center and dispersion of masked astronomical samples or background boxes.

source_references.title: Astropy biweight location and midvariance estimators
Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)

canonical_equations: Median M and MAD; u=(x-M)/(c*MAD), abs(u)<1. location=M+sum((x-M)*(1-u^2)^2)/sum((1-u^2)^2); midvariance=n*sum((x-M)^2*(1-u^2)^4)/sum((1-u^2)*(1-5*u^2))^2; scale=sqrt(midvariance), ordered RN32.
output_contract: B x [u32 status,valid_count,f32 median,MAD,location,midvariance,scale,u32 location_inliers,variance_inliers]; status1 empty,2 MAD0,3 degenerate denominator; failed records retain only status/count. n counts all valid observations; no universal variance calibration.
result_contract: B x [u32 status,valid_count,f32 median,MAD,location,midvariance,scale,u32 location_inliers,variance_inliers]; status1 empty,2 MAD0,3 degenerate denominator; failed records retain only status/count. n counts all valid observations; no universal variance calibration.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
